segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: A blank check company that has not commenced operations and seeks a business combination with a target business.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has determined that the Company only has one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: No operating revenue; its only income is interest earned on IPO proceeds held in the trust account.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company will generate non-operating income in the form of interest income from the proceeds derived from the IPO.
